author: ALM
body:
Hello everyone!
  
Today I am happy to announce a new feature that I rolled out to Atlas a few hours ago. This feature is called executors. Now you may be asking, "What are executors?", well, instead of explaining it in very technical terms, I'll just provide some examples.

Let's say a player breaks a block. When that happens any executors registered for that event will attempt to execute. Now, each executor has a check associated with it which will be performed before the executor executes. In this example, let's say the check checks that the material is glass. So, to recap, a player breaks a block, a check is tested (block is glass), and if the block is glass, the executor will be performed.  So, at this point, the check has passed, but, what will happen? There are a number of executors that can be performed.

 You can:
  • Modify Lives
  • Toggle Elimination
  • Replace Blocks
  • Enchant Items
  • Play Sounds
  • Summon Entities
  • Take Items
  • Teleport Players
  • Apply Loadouts
  • Modify Scores
  • Paste Schematics
  • Change World Time
Now, let me give you a more complex example: Let's say a hill is captured. If the hill is capture by a certain team who also has a monument destroyed, a glass wall will be pasted in and 6 zombies wearing chain helmets and gold boots with the custom name "ZOMBO" will be spawned on the other side to fight the other team. Another use-case is that if a certain time has passed and no objectives are completed, elimination will be enabled and players swords will be enchanted with sharpness X.

You can read the detailed documentation on each of the executors and triggers here.

Thanks,
ALM
